description: Fired when the user confirms the two-step Delete button. Persist with system.user.removeHoliday(event.name) and refresh the data.holidays binding. Capability flags only hide UI: a crafted client can send this event with any payload, so check the session user's roles and re-read the flags here on the gateway before writing (see the adminAuth reference library).

name.description: Name of the holiday to delete.
